[EN] Keepers of the Sun
[ES] Guardianes del Sol
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] The Consos are unusual, even for baraka.
[ES] Los Conso son inusuales, incluso para los baraka.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Now to find Rida.
[ES] Ahora a buscar a Rida.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll get to it!"
[ES] ¡Me encargaré de eso!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] [{@Rgn:30010#Camp Sunlight}] Find {@linkcreature:230#1007$$Lashinuk}.
[ES] [{@Rgn:30010#Camp Sunlight}] Encuentra a {@linkcreature:230#1007$$Lashinuk}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Brass Warden Gear
[ES] Equipo de guardián de bronce
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] [{@Rgn:30002$$High Vale}] Defeat the {@linkcreature:30#2004#brass warden} and collect a gear.
[ES] [{@Rgn:30002$$High Vale}] Derrota al {@linkcreature:30#2004#brass warden} y consigue una pieza de equipo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the gear to {@LinkCreature:230#1007$$Lashinuk}.
[ES] Entréguele el equipo a {@LinkCreature:230#1007$$Lashinuk}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll go find her, then."
[ES] Iré a buscarla entonces.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Seren's Garden
[ES] Jardín de Seren
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Look for Rida in the pavilion.
[ES] Busca a Rida en el pabellón.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] [{@Rgn:30005$$Seren's Garden}] Look for Rida in {@Rgn:30005$$Seren's Garden}.
[ES] [{@Rgn:30005$$Seren's Garden}] Busca a Rida en {@Rgn:30005$$Seren's Garden}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "He won't escape!"
[ES] ¡No escapará!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Help {@linkcreature:230#1081$$Rida} find and open Seren's seal.
[ES] Ayuda a {@linkcreature:230#1081$$Rida} a encontrar y abrir el sello de Seren.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Break the final seal.
[ES] Rompe el sello final.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll talk to Lashinuk."
[ES] Hablaré con Lashinuk.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find {@linkcreature:230#1081$$Rida}.
[ES] Encuentra a {@linkcreature:230#1081$$Rida}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Best I go, then."
[ES] Será mejor que vaya entonces.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] [{@Rgn:30010#Camp Sunlight}] Return to {@linkcreature:230#1007$$Lashinuk}.
[ES] [{@Rgn:30010#Camp Sunlight}] Regresa con {@linkcreature:230#1007$$Lashinuk}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Don't worry."
[ES] No te preocupes.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] [{@Rgn:30007$$Balder's Pavilion}] Collect tablet fragments from the strongboxes in the {@Rgn:30007$$Pavilion}.
[ES] [{@Rgn:30007$$Balder's Pavilion}] Recolecta fragmentos de tablilla de las cajas fuertes en el {@Rgn:30007$$Pavilion}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the tablet parts to {@linkcreature:230#1015$$Elsine}.
[ES] Entrega las partes de la tablilla a {@linkcreature:230#1015$$Elsine}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Control Scroll
[ES] Pergamino de control
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] [{@Rgn:30009$$Lower Archives}] Retrieve the control scrolls from the {@linkcreature:30#130$$sloth foragers}.
[ES] [{@Rgn:30009$$Lower Archives}] Recupera los pergaminos de control de los {@linkcreature:30#130$$sloth forrajeadores}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Return {@linkcreature:230#1015$$Elsine}'s control scrolls.
[ES] Devuelve los pergaminos de control de {@linkcreature:230#1015$$Elsine}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Yes, let's see it."
[ES] "Sí, vamos a verlo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Insert the finished tablet and control scrolls into the Repository of Wisdom.
[ES] Inserta la tablilla terminada y los pergaminos de control en el Repositorio de la Sabiduría.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll do my best."
[ES] "Haré mi mejor esfuerzo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Give {@linkcreature:230#1015$$Elsine} the parchments from the repository.
[ES] Dale a {@linkcreature:230#1015$$Elsine} los pergaminos del repositorio.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
